snippet.title: Loot Loop - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist on Steam:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3972320/Loot_Loop/

Loot Loop is a relaxing incremental dungeon crawler featuring short runs, rewarding upgrades, and a cozy retro pixel art style – dive into dungeons, fight monsters, and grow stronger every run.
